---
title: "Community contributions"
subtitle: "Reviewing, editing, and publishing community submissions"
---

The `ISA RC42 Community Submissions` spreadsheet serves as the editorial inbox for announcements submitted by members and colleagues through the website contact form. Submissions remain private until an administrator reviews and approves them for publication.

## Where the information is stored

Submissions are managed in Google Drive:

```
Google Drive
└── Core Spreadsheets
    └── ISA RC42 Community Submissions
        └── Tab: Editorial Review
```

## Review and publish a submission

To review and publish a contribution:

1. Open Google Drive and open `ISA RC42 Community Submissions`.
2. Select the `Editorial Review` tab.
3. Locate the row containing the submission you want to review.
4. Review the submitted text. Optionally enter a revised headline in `edited_title` or a concise summary in `edited_description`.
5. Set `review_status` to `approved`.
6. Set `publish_on_site` to `yes`.
7. Set `display_member_name_authorized` to `yes` if the contributor authorized displaying their name, or `no` to publish anonymously.
8. Wait for the daily automatic update at 12:00 UTC or trigger an immediate update manually.

::: {.callout-note}
## Publication condition

An item is published only when both conditions are met: `review_status` is set to `approved` and `publish_on_site` is set to `yes`. If either field is not set, the item remains unpublished.
:::

## Editorial fields reference

| Field | Purpose | Accepted values |
|:---|:---|:---|
| `review_status` | Editorial decision for the submission | `pending`, `approved`, or `rejected` |
| `publish_on_site` | Controls publication to the website | `yes` or `no` |
| `edited_title` | Revised title displayed on the website | Text (leaves original `submission_title` intact) |
| `edited_description` | Revised summary displayed on the website | Text (leaves original `short_description` intact) |
| `display_member_name_authorized` | Controls display of contributor name | `yes` or `no` |
| `relevant_date` | Event date or deadline | Date in `YYYY-MM-DD` format (e.g. `2026-11-15`) |
| `suggested_tags` | Subject keywords for search and filtering | Comma-separated terms (e.g. `conference, call, identity`) |

## What happens after approval

When the synchronization process runs:

1. The script reads approved rows from the `Editorial Review` tab.
2. Private fields (`submitter_email`, editorial notes, internal comments) are stripped automatically so that personal contact data is never exposed.
3. The script generates public data files and updates the website RSS feed (`feeds/community-contributions.xml`).
4. Quarto compiles and deploys the updated [Community Contributions page](https://isa-rc42.org/news/community-contributions.html).

## Checking the published contribution

To verify that the contribution is online:

1. Open `https://isa-rc42.org/news/community-contributions.html` in your web browser.
2. Confirm that the title, description, relevant dates, and links appear correctly.
3. If the page does not reflect recent changes, refresh your browser cache using `Ctrl + F5` (Windows) or `Cmd + Shift + R` (Mac).

## Common problems

* **Contribution does not appear online:** Check that `review_status` is set to `approved` and `publish_on_site` is set to `yes`. If either value is missing, the submission is skipped.
* **Renamed column headers:** Never change existing column names in the spreadsheet. The automation script relies on exact header names to identify fields.
* **Invalid date format:** Enter dates in `relevant_date` using `YYYY-MM-DD` (for example, `2026-10-30`).
